newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom to detail listing Friday.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom to detail listing Friday.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, the German telecommunications giant, said on Tuesday that it would provide a detailed time-plan of its 15-billion-mark share launch at a news conference on Friday at 0900 GMT.

Telekom chief finance officer Joachim Kroeske will present the company's preliminary sales prospectcus that it will present to potential investors at so-called roadshows this month ahead of the November listing in Germany and New York.

The listing is expected to be the largest-ever in Europe, but details of the numbers of shares to be offered to the public, the volume of capital and the share price will not be made known until shortly before the flotation.
